name: AppBar
description: Top navigation bar. Fixed at the top of every page. Contains the logo, navigation menu items, user avatar, and notification icon. Two variants: DefaultUser (logged-in user's own session) and OtherUser (viewing as another user).

type.description: DefaultUser=standard session; OtherUser=impersonation/viewing as another user.

actions.note: Right side: notifications + avatar + quick actions

avatar.note: User avatar — opens user menu on click

usage.notes: Render once at the app root. Position fixed top. Use z-index above panels and modals.

do: Keep logo always visible and linked to home.
Keep action count in the right area minimal (≤4 icons).
dont: Don't add page-specific actions to AppBar — use Panel headers.
Don't change AppBar background per page.
